name: FUNSD: Form Understanding in Noisy Scanned Documents
description: A specialized benchmark dataset for form understanding and document intelligence developed by the Computer Vision Laboratory at EPFL. Comprises 199 fully annotated scanned forms selected from the RVL-CDIP and Tobacco3482 document collections. Contains 31,485 individual words, 9,707 semantic entities categorized into header, question, answer, and other, and 5,304 directed relation links between questions and corresponding answers.
